external_collaboration.evidence_quote: As a member of The Dutch Alliance (TDA), we work with eight leading VET institutions to strengthen international cooperation in vocational education. 🔗 More information on the website of The Dutch Alliance.

Through The Dutch Alliance, Rijn IJssel is part of the Network of Networks (NoN)—a European collaboration between educational networks from the Basque Country, Finland, Northern Ireland, Ireland, Scotland, and the Netherlands. NoN promotes international learning experiences and sustainable partnerships between schools, creating opportunities for students and staff to grow across borders.

Thanks to our location near the German border, we’re closely connected to European partners—especially within the EUREGIO Rhine-Waal. This cross-border region fosters collaboration between Dutch and German institutions, aiming to create a shared space for learning, working, and growing together.
